highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.152.0 previews Graphite GPU bindings for Vulkan, Metal, and Dawn, built on Skia m152.
highlights_body: Adds a new async pixel-readback API, several memory-leak and performance fixes, a Vulkan/Silk.NET package, and FreeType-based font support on Nano Server.

bullets.lead: Updated to Skia Chrome milestone m152
bullets.detail: Bundles the Skia m152 engine, including merged chrome/m151 and m152 upstream bug fixes.
Adds bindings for Skia's Graphite GPU backend across Vulkan, Metal, and Dawn.
SKImage and SKSurface gain RequestReadPixels for asynchronous, backend-neutral pixel access.
Adds a Silk.NET-based Vulkan interop package, with Vulkan tests now running on Android and Linux.
SKRegion.SpanIterator, SKPixmap.ExtractSubset/With*, and the SKImage raster-create failure path now correctly root or free native memory instead of leaving dangling pointers.
Caches a skip-registration reflection check, avoids an intermediate string allocation in GetEncodedText, pre-sizes a uniform lookup map, and avoids a double buffer copy in SKData.SaveTo.

bullets.lead: FreeType font support on Nano Server
bullets.detail: Nano Server now uses FreeType for font rendering, since the platform lacks the usual system font APIs.
Adds Azure Linux, Alpine/musl, and Nano Server containerized CI test legs for broader platform coverage.

preview_summaries.v4.152.0-preview.1.1: Preview 1 introduces the Graphite GPU backend bindings, async pixel readback, the Vulkan/Silk.NET package, several native use-after-free and performance fixes, and updates the engine to Skia m152.

harfbuzz_summary: Converts the HarfBuzzSharp solution to .slnx and adds the new containerized test legs alongside the SkiaSharp infra changes.
